evidence.C1: Calm hint 'Watch the water, or sit for a while' and rich sound list, but 'Drag across the screen to peel the lint' feels abstract rather than tactile.
evidence.C2: Strong laundry-specific gestures: 'DRAG each coin into the slot', lint peel, pegs, smoothing, and folding in thirds.
evidence.C3: Coherent pastel laundromat and readable HUD, but low-poly shirts, flat water, and simple textures keep it from feeling distinctive.
evidence.C4: Clear next-step hints like 'Tap the green slot to feed in a note' and 'Now fold the right side in', with progress shown in 'This load'.

fixes: Make every interaction physically anchored and tactile: drag coins visibly into slots, peel lint on the trap itself, and add cloth deformation, particles, and varied sound feedback for each touch.
Raise visual craft with deliberate materials, lighting, and textures: less flat low-poly shirts/water, richer laundromat surfaces, and a more distinctive art direction worth screenshotting.
Tighten phone clarity and affordances: prevent HUD crowding, highlight the exact interactive object, and show a hand/cursor or target glow so first-time users know where to touch.

evidence.C1: Calm mint/warm-white palette, visible water + foam in drum, drips on hanging shirts, canvas-erased lint peel, drag-speed-tied smoothing sound; 30 sound ids + ambient bed. Not quite 'every touch' tactile — coin scoop and detergent pour read as taps rather than physical gestures.
evidence.C2: All real-coin-laundry beats present and gesture-matched: changer with note feed + coin cascade, detergent drawer, DRAG coin into slot, lint trap with drag-peel, pegs, smoothing, fold left/right/bottom. Only minor gap: no visible detergent pour animation or coin-ledge micro-detail shown.
evidence.C3: Coherent art direction (mint subway tile, warm whites, red accents, matching HUD with 'bilas COIN LAUNDRY' wordmark, station underline). But shirts read flat/2D, washers are generic primitives, lighting is flat — pleasant but not 'designer would screenshot' distinctive.
evidence.C4: Every screenshot shows a clear one-line hint ('Tap the green slot to feed in a note', 'Drag across the screen to peel the lint', 'Now fold the right side in'), red underline on next station, THIS LOAD card tracks each shirt, coin purse visible. Minor: no first-run intro overlay for total newcomers.

fixes: Push C3: give shirts real cloth thickness/shading, add deliberate window light + cast shadows, and a distinctive laundromat signature (worn signage, scuffed floor, a poster) so the space reads as designed rather than default primitives.

Push C1: add tactile visual payoff to the under-served beats — visible detergent stream into the drawer, coin clatter physics on the scoop, water splash on shirt load, cloth sag as it dries — so every touch (not just smooth/peel) has a payoff.

Push C4: add a 3-step first-run intro card (Change → Wash → Dry/Hang/Fold) that auto-dismisses, and a subtle pulse/glow on the currently-afforded 3D object so first-time users instantly see what is interactive on phone and desktop.

evidence.C1: Strong pairing of visual+sound payoff: 'canvas-erased texture, peel sound', 'hand-on-cotton sound tied to drag speed', 'drips slow as they dry'; stills show foam/water in drum, lint on trap, visible wrinkles; Sit station + rain ambience invite lingering. Docked: the wrinkle overlay reads as rough scribble lines rather than cloth flattening, and audio quality can't be confirmed from stills.
evidence.C2: Nearly the full 10-anchor inventory with matched gestures: changer ('feed a note... coins cascade'), 'DRAG each coin into the slot', 'pour detergent into the drawer', lint trap pull-and-peel, 'wooden pegs', 'fold left sleeve, right sleeve, bottom up' / 'Now fold the right side in'. Docked for missing neighbourhood extras (no openable drawer, no bench despite the 'leave it on the bench' note).
evidence.C3: Coherent mint/cream/red art direction, custom 'bilas COIN LAUNDRY' HUD, green LCD 'WASH 0:26', 'Lost: grey sock' note, red machine numbers. Docked: drum clothes are angular low-poly blobs, changer body and fold table are plain slabs — short of 'a designer would screenshot'.
evidence.C4: Specific always-on hints ('Tap the green slot to feed in a note.', 'Now fold the right side in.'), 'This load' card with per-shirt states and timers keep progress visible; G2 passed at both sizes. Docked: in the lint-peel screenshot the next-step underline points to Fold while the load is '2 dry · 2 wet' and two shirts still need hanging.

fixes: Rework the weakest tactile visuals: replace the sketchy wrinkle overlay with a cloth-flattening effect and soften the angular low-poly shirt blobs in the drum — biggest lever on C1+C3 (0.55 combined weight).
Fix the next-step underline logic: during lint peel it underlines Fold while two shirts are still wet and must be hung first; it should always reflect the true next required station.
Close the fidelity gap to the 10 anchor: openable detergent drawer, a bench by the window for the Sit station, and similar small neighbourhood-laundry details.
